title: Concrete beam (expected to fail)
summary: Real photos of a cracked reinforced-concrete beam under a piston. The surface has too little texture to track, so the app stops early. It shows what photos that don't work look like.

expected.label: Result
expected.note: Too few points tracked: the concrete has too little texture

credit.creators: A. Sjölander, V. Belloni, V. Peterson, J. Ledin
credit.title: Monitoring of structural performance of cracked reinforced concrete using DIC and CMfM
credit.changes: Beam 5, fixed camera IB only. Eight photos kept: the start of the test and the pauses at 10–60 kN. Each cropped to (600, 480)–(5350, 3744), halved to 2375 × 1632 px and saved as JPEG quality 95. The force at each pause written to concrete_loads.csv (kN); frame_index.csv lists each photo's time, force and piston displacement.
